The method was posted yesterday by a researcher who uses the handles MSNightmare and Nightmare Eclipse, and the endpoint-security firm ThreatLocker.

cybersecurity.title: phpAfterShell Explained: How Hackers Could Turn a PHP Session Flaw Into Code Execution
cybersecurity.summary: PHP's default file-based session storage can be made to return objects an attacker chose, by cutting off a session write at the right moment. When combined with a second weakness, such as a suitable gadget chain in the app, those objects can allow the attacker to run code on the server. Today's PHP releases fix the flaw, called phpAfterShell.

cybersecurity.title: Patchujcie PHP – request smuggling, UAF i pokłosie php2shell.

cybersecurity.title: Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day Flaw Lets Network Attackers Bypass Authentication
cybersecurity.summary: A critical flaw in VMware vCenter lets an attacker with network access bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system, Broadcom, which owns VMware, said in an advisory published today. Fixed versions are out for all supported branches, and the company lists no workaround. vCenter is the central console for managing an organization's ESX hosts and virtual machines.

cybersecurity.title: Drupal Patches Critical Installer Flaw That Could Give Unauthenticated Attackers Control of Sites
cybersecurity.summary: Under specific conditions, a critical vulnerability in Drupal core can allow an attacker without login credentials to use the built-in installer to attempt to reinstall a site. That can lead to a site takeover or remote code execution, and the project rates the vulnerable configurations as uncommon. Fixed releases for all supported branches shipped yesterday.

cybersecurity.title: Kolejne krytyczne podatności w PHP. Zadbaj o aktualizację
